description: CamboJA documents a distinct Freedom Park Human Rights Day event and release calls, but reports no event-specific attendance total.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous organizer, participant or local-media evidence giving the simultaneous Freedom Park turnout and confirming the release demand as part of that gathering.

description: STT’s Democracy Square Human Rights Day activity has a date/location photo caption and rights/freedom theme, but no site-specific count or explicit domestic state addressee. Its >1,000 figure spans multiple sites/communities and cannot be transferred to this event.
required_followup: Review event-specific organizer/participant records and contemporaneous local reporting for simultaneous turnout and an explicit demand to the Cambodian government/policy; keep each community site separate unless coordination is documented.

description: CCHR announced a 6 December physical event at its office and a campaign calling on the Royal Government of Cambodia to end GBV and promote gender equality. The captured announcement does not prove the event occurred or establish attendance. The 10 December announcement concerned publication of a timeline, not a gathering.
required_followup: Locate a post-event record or contemporaneous coverage confirming execution, public attendance, turnout and the action’s actual demands.

description: RFA describes NagaWorld protests as recurring almost monthly and more than 100 workers still on strike in December, but provides no date/site-specific gathering count for December. Strike onset was 18 December 2021; layoffs of about 1,300 workers are not attendance.
required_followup: Seek a December 2024 dated contemporaneous report or organizer statement that establishes a discrete public gathering, site/time, simultaneous participants, and whether demands were directed to the company or state policy.

description: Seven recorded English/Khmer searches covered broad December discovery, Human Rights Day sites, CCHR’s announced campaign event, labor/land issues and NagaWorld continuity. Searches do not reproduce local archives/LexisNexis or establish exhaustive coverage. A Freedom Park event, a Democracy Square activity, the Night Market vigil and multi-province community activities remain distinct.
required_followup: Continue feasible Khmer local/regional archive and organizer searches for December Human Rights Day, labor and land actions; save exact query input before each request and do not combine sites based on shared date or theme.
